page.layout: One printed page. At the top right, faint lines of text in the right margin area. In the centre, a large woodcut ornamental frame with a figure, flames and mountains, and a date in its base. Below the woodcut, short centred lines of faint type.
page.notes: The main part of the page is a woodcut frame with an ornamental capital-like letter, a figure, flames, mountains and a small date in the base. It is an illustration, not text, and is not transcribed. The faint lines at the top right and below the woodcut are very light and cannot be read on the scan. Some of them may be show-through from the reverse side, so the line count and placement are approximate. The lines are marked illegible rather than guessed. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is visible.
